voiceLine: Your patient has a virus. They want antibiotics, just in case. What do you say?

card.text: Viral URI. Client asks for an
A. "I'll get you one, just in case."
D. "Start one if the fever lasts."

answer: B. Antibiotics act on bacteria, not viruses. Taking them when not needed adds side effects and drives antibiotic resistance. A and D promote inappropriate use; C is self-medicating with leftovers.
